To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) young adults with T1D and MDD reported a need for online resources that are tailored to their unique needs and concerns; and (2) young adults reported that they would be more likely to seek online resources if they had a positive experience with a mental health professional.

young adults with type 1 diabetes who have experienced a mental illness or mental health problem are more likely to seek information from online sources than those without such experiences, and that they are likely to use online sources to seek information that is relevant to their mental health and diabetes.

the role of social media in the lives of young adults who are diagnosed with type 1 diabetes and who experience mental health problems.
the ways in which young people living with diabetes are using social media to access information about mental health and diabetes.
